features: Ultra-Compact Mini Design: Stylish and lightweight phone that easily fits in your pocket for travel and backup use
Bluetooth Dialer Function: Connect with your smartphone and make or receive calls directly from the device
Dual Nano SIM Support: Use two SIM cards simultaneously for better connectivity and network flexibility
800mAh Battery Backup: Reliable battery for daily basic usage and extended standby time
Multi-Language and 3G GSM Support: Supports multiple languages with stable GSM network compatibility for wide coverage
Compact Display Screen: Features a 0.66-inch display screen that provides clear visibility for calls and basic functions
Lightweight Feature Phone: Designed as a simple and convenient mobile device for users who prefer basic calling functionality
description: The G’FIVE mini keypad mobile is a compact and stylish feature phone designed for convenience and portability. Equipped with a 0.66-inch display and Bluetooth dialer functionality, it allows seamless connectivity with your smartphone. With dual nano SIM support, 800mAh battery, and GSM/2G network compatibility, this device is perfect as a backup phone or for users who prefer a simple and lightweight mobile experience.
